title: Q7
description:
Read: Psa 22:1-2, Psa 22:22-24, Isa 50:4-6

The cry is forsakenness, and the hearing is that God has not despised it. The servant is given an opened ear, does not turn back, and gives his back to the strikers.

a) Prayers were heard. What does heard mean, if the cry is forsakenness and the hearing is that the cry was not despised?

b) He learned obedience by what He suffered. The servant does not rebel. What is there to learn, if it is not learning to stop sinning?
